title: Data Engineer (Supply Chain) - Clearance Required
description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking a **Supply Chain Data Analyst / Engineer** to integrate and analyze complex parts, supplier, procurement, inventory, and risk data in support of industrial base decisions. This individual will build repeatable workflows that connect an indentured parts list to relevant government and commercial data, resolve inconsistent identifiers, and make analytical findings traceable to their sources. Working closely with supply chain analysts and technical experts, the Data Analyst / Engineer will help the team identify potential constraints at scale and focus manual investigation where it will have the greatest value. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering and analytical skills with an interest in defense logistics and supply chain challenges.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

* Ingest, clean, transform, and integrate parts, assembly, supplier, procurement, inventory, and risk datasets.
* Develop methods to match part numbers, NSNs/NIINs, CAGE codes, drawing identifiers, and other inconsistent records.
* Build and maintain a structured assessment dataset that connects parts to higher assemblies, sources, evidence, risks, and actions.
* Automate repeatable screening and data quality checks while routing ambiguous matches for analyst review.
* Document data lineage, refresh dates, matching logic, and confidence measures.
* Develop analytical queries and views that surface long lead times, supplier concentration, stock-outs, delivery delays, and other potential constraints.
* Partner with domain experts to develop and validate lead-time, capacity, or schedule estimates where appropriate.
* Support rolling updates as new parts lists, procurement records, and supplier information become available.
* Translate user needs into practical data products and explain the limitations of the underlying data.

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Experience integrating, transforming, and analyzing data from multiple sources.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python or comparable data processing tools.
* Experience designing structured datasets, data pipelines, and quality assurance checks.

* Experience producing analytical outputs that can be reviewed and used by nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to work with subject matter experts.
* Ability to document assumptions, data provenance, and analytical limitations.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with defense logistics, procurement, inventory, or supplier datasets.
* Familiarity with NSNs/NIINs, CAGE codes, bills of materials, and assembly hierarchies.
* Experience with entity resolution, graph analysis, or supply network mapping.
* Experience developing lead-time, capacity, or schedule models in partnership with domain experts.

OtterSoft is building an AI-ready workforce management platform powered by a sophisticated semantic data architecture. We are seeking a **Knowledge Graph / Data Integration Engineer** to build and maintain the pipelines and services that keep our ontology accurate, connected, and current.

You will work closely with the Ontology Architect, product, engineering, and business stakeholders to implement semantic data integrations, operationalize business logic, and build dependable services for applications, dashboards, and AI-enabled workflows.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain data pipelines that load source-system data into ontology objects and relationships in both batch and near-real-time processing environments.
* Expose ontology data through APIs and query endpoints for applications, dashboards, and AI agents.
* Apply appropriate data security and privacy controls, including access rules, encryption, audit logging, and data minimization for sensitive information.
* Collaborate with the Ontology Architect to ensure data mappings, relationships, and derived logic align with the enterprise ontology.
* Document data pipelines, integrations, quality checks, operational procedures, and troubleshooting steps.
* Identify opportunities to improve pipeline reliability, data consistency, performance, and scalability.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable data ingestion and transformation pipelines.
* Integrate data from multiple SaaS and operational systems using REST APIs, webhooks, SFTP, and flat-file exports.
* Transform and map source-system records into ontology objects, properties, and relationships.
* Implement entity resolution, deduplication, and master-record matching across source systems.
* Develop and maintain data-quality validation, monitoring, error handling, and recovery processes.
* Build services and query interfaces that make ontology data accessible to downstream applications and AI-enabled workflows.
* Work with the Ontology Architect to implement derived properties and rules and validate their behavior against business requirements.
* Apply secure engineering practices for sensitive data, including appropriate access controls, encryption, auditability, and minimization.
* Troubleshoot integration failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues, and implement durable fixes.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver dependable, maintainable data services.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in data engineering, data integration, or a closely related discipline.
* At least 1 year of experience working with a graph database, ontology platform, or semantic-layer technology.
* Strong Python and SQL skills.
* Experience with Spark or PySpark and a data orchestration or transformation tool such as Airflow, dbt, or Foundry Pipeline Builder.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: Palantir Foundry, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or an RDF triple store, including the relevant query language or tooling.
* Experience integrating SaaS and operational systems through REST APIs, webhooks, SFTP, and flat-file exports.
* Understanding of data modeling, data transformation, entity resolution, and data-quality practices.
* Experience building, monitoring, and troubleshooting production data pipelines.
* Ability to work with technical and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve data issues.
* Working knowledge of secure data-handling practices, including access controls, encryption, audit logging, and data minimization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code and automated deployment practices.
* Experience using TypeScript or React to build internal tools or applications that consume ontology data.
* Experience supporting AI applications or agents through reliable data services, graph queries, or semantic data access.

**Competencies**

* Strong data engineering and integration skills, with attention to reliability and maintainability.
* Analytical problem-solving and a methodical approach to diagnosing data issues.
* Attention to detail when mapping entities, relationships, and business rules.
* Ability to build robust pipelines and services that support production applications.
* Commitment to data quality, security, documentation, and operational monitoring.
* Effective communication and collaboration with architecture, engineering, product, and business teams.
* Ability to manage priorities and resolve issues in a fast-moving platform environment.

**Culture Fit**

You will thrive here if:

* Take ownership of data quality and investigate issues before they affect downstream users.
* Are comfortable working across multiple source systems and evolving technical requirements.
* Value clear documentation, testing, monitoring, and secure engineering practices.
* Collaborate closely with architects and engineers to turn semantic models into working data services.
* Look for practical ways to improve automation, reliability, and platform performance.

You may not thrive here if:

* Prefer one-off data tasks over maintaining production pipelines and integrations.
* Have limited experience troubleshooting data quality or integration issues.
* Treat monitoring, testing, documentation, or security as secondary concerns.
* Prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with architecture and application teams.

**Why Join Us**

Your work will directly influence the reliability of matching, compliance, forecasting, and intelligent automation across the platform. If you enjoy solving complex integration challenges and building production-grade data services that make connected data useful, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: $128,000.00 - $222,000.00 per year

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Fusion is looking for a DevOps Engineer to join us in Woodbridge, NJ, helping build and scale the infrastructure behind our healthcare platform, someone who's as comfortable automating deployments as they are hardening CI/CD pipelines and keeping our systems reliable under real-world load. You'll work closely with our engineering team to keep things running smoothly and securely, while helping us raise the bar on how we ship software. If you like owning infrastructure end to end and care about doing it right in a space where reliability actually matters, we'd love to talk.

**About Fusion Health**  
Most healthcare software is built for the easy cases. Fusion Health builds for the rest.

We support clinicians working in movement restricted communities, where care delivery is more complex and software reliability is critical. In these environments, systems need to work consistently because there is no room for failure. This has been our focus since 2006.

That is not an accident. It is who we hire.

Bryan Jakovcic(EY Entrepreneur of the Year) built this company and still personally interviews every single person who joins it. Because the people here are not a department or a headcount. They are the company. Fusion has been recognized by INC as one of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for four consecutive years, including #8 in New Jersey and #38 in the NY Tri-State area, and by Deloitte on its Fast 500 list of fastest-growing technology companies in the United States. We are also proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work by Fortune!. That growth and recognition happened because the right people showed up and did something with it.

We are driven, self aware, and we own what we do. That is the culture. No more, no less.

If this is the kind of work you've been looking for, this is where you do the best work of your career.

**What we offer:**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401K
* Generous PTO

**What You'll Do:**

This role is vital to our organization's mission and growth, and if selected, you'll work on the following challenging and interesting projects:

* Maintain our current GitLab CI pipelines while leading their migration to GitHub Actions, integrated with Octopus Deploy for releases, covering build, test, artifact publishing, and database deployments.
* Plan, analyze, and migrate repositories, metadata, and version history from legacy platforms (GitLab, Octopus, etc) into GitHub Enterprise.
* Develop and maintain Terraform for per-client environments and reusable modules, with every change reviewed through merge requests and applied through the pipeline
* Deploy and operate applications on Azure App Services and Azure Container Apps, and automate the build and deployment paths that move legacy VM-hosted workloads onto them
* Build and maintain container workflows, including tagging, package registry management, and promotion across environments
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting in Datadog and Azure so deployment failures and performance regressions surface quickly
* Participate in incident response and the on-call rotation, run blameless post-incident reviews, and automate fixes for recurring issues
* Build security in the delivery pipeline (secrets handling, SAST, SCA, Managed Identity and Service Principal configuration, least privilege access, dependency scanning, etc) in partnership with security and compliance teams
* Improve developer experience and delivery performance by standardizing pipeline templates, shortening build times, and tracking deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore service

**Who You Are:**

We believe in harnessing diverse talents and perspectives, and if you believe you have what it takes to excel in this role, we want to hear from you. We look forward to reviewing your application if you have the following qualifications and experience:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
* 3 to 5 years of hands-on DevOps, build and release, or site reliability experience, including at least 2 years in Azure
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines with tools such as GitLab CI, Octopus Deploy, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions, including Git branching and merge request workflows
* Strong Terraform skills and scripting ability in PowerShell, Bash, or Python
* Working knowledge of the Azure services used in application delivery: App Services, Container Apps, Azure SQL, Managed Identity, and Azure Front Door
* Hands-on experience with building and deploying .NET applications through automated pipelines
* Experience supporting production systems, including observability tooling, incident response, and on call
* Understanding of DevSecOps practices: secrets management, least-privilege access, identity configuration, and securing CI/CD pipelines
* Ideal Fusionites are strong problem solvers who work independently, write clear documentation for pipelines and runbooks, share knowledge across teams, and bring a fun, energetic personality

**Nice to Have:**

* Hands-on experience migrating .NET workloads from IIS on Windows VMs to Azure PaaS services such as App Services or Container Apps
* Experience working with Azure networking, including VNETs, subnets, Network Security Groups, Application Gateway, and traffic routing and failover patterns
* Exposure to Azure integration services such as Service Bus, Data Factory, or Logic Apps
* Experience delivering in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST), including change control, audit trails, and access reviews
* Microsoft Azure certification, ideally AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert) or AZ-104 (Azure Administrator)

**Additional Details:**

* This is a Hybrid full time, salaried role based in our Woodbridge, NJ office.
* Our normal hours of operation are Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM.
* This position description is not intended to be exhaustive, and other duties may be assigned as they arise.
* It is not expected that applicants have any familiarity with Fusion’s proprietary applications, Healthcare software, or Corrections/Public Health business processes. Qualified candidates will be able to demonstrate related experience and transferable skills that will work well with the Fusion team.
* At this time, this position is not eligible for employment sponsorship.
* Fusion is an equal employment opportunity employer.

**Compensation:**

* Salary Range: 120,000-140,000
* At Fusion, our salary ranges are designed to be competitive within our size and industry. Compensation is just one component of a comprehensive total rewards package that also includes benefits, flexibility, and growth opportunities.
* Individual pay decisions are informed by several factors, including location, experience, qualifications, skillset, and internal equity across the organization. While we expect most offers to fall within the stated range, each compensation decision is made thoughtfully, with consideration for both the candidate’s unique profile and our commitment to pay parity.

title: DevOps Engineer, Platform
description:
Overview:

A great platform team is defined not by how many tickets it closes, but by how little friction stands between an engineer's idea and a running service. The DevOps Engineer, Platform builds and runs the pipelines, golden paths, service infrastructure, and AI-augmented workflows that make delivery self-service at Origami Risk.

This engineer is a hands-on member of the DevOps Platform team who onboards new services, builds and maintains CI/CD pipelines, authors infrastructure as code, deploys and operates containerized and serverless workloads, and keeps the path from lower environments to production reliable. Everything runs in AWS, on top of the landing zone the DevOps Infrastructure team owns. The role works from the team's established standards and patterns, contributes improvements back to them, and partners with Engineering, Release, SRE, and DevOps Infrastructure to deliver services and resolve delivery issues. On this team, manual work is a problem to be solved, automation is the default, and every Engineer is expected to use AI to work faster and diagnose more accurately, while understanding and owning every change they ship.

Starting base pay for this role is between $100,000 and $122,000. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states).

  
Responsibilities:

What This Team Runs:

This is the developer platform and delivery layer that sits on top of the AWS landing zone: the systems Engineering uses to build, ship, and operate services every day. The team owns the platform for application and service delivery, not the landing zone underneath it, which the DevOps Infrastructure team owns. The team owns:

* Delivery Pipelines & Build: the CI/CD build and deploy pipelines, and the shared pipeline templates that Engineering teams across the org use to ship every day.
* Service-Layer IaC: the infrastructure-as-code that defines each service's cloud resources, versioned and deployed through Terraform.
* Kubernetes & Container Platform: the Kubernetes container platform and the self-service golden path that lets a new service onboard with no bespoke infrastructure work.
* Application Connectivity: the application-facing API gateways, service DNS, and certificates that make services reachable and secure.
* Service Data & Configuration: the application data stores, configuration, and secrets that each service depends on.
* Environment Promotion: the promotion path that moves a change safely from lower environments to production.
* AI & Internal Tooling: the AI tooling across the development lifecycle that speeds service onboarding, pipeline authoring, and day-to-day delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

Developer Platform & Service Onboarding

* Onboards new services and greenfield projects through the team's self-service golden path, from repository scaffolding and infrastructure provisioning through pipelines, configuration, secrets, DNS, and alerting, taking each service from “we are building a service” to “it deploys to production on its own pipeline.”
* Supports high-velocity delivery for new product initiatives, including AI projects, by enabling Day-1 deployment from initial repo creation through infrastructure provisioning, application deployment, observability, and production readiness.
* Applies the team's naming and structural standards for repositories, container images, pipelines, configuration, and secrets, and flags gaps where a standard is missing or unclear.
* Supports cost efficiency by right-sizing service infrastructure, applying image and artifact retention policies, and cleaning up idle or unused resources.

Pipelines, Build & Release

* Builds, maintains, and troubleshoots CI/CD build and deploy pipelines (build, test, scan, containerize, publish, deploy, and the environment gates between them) using the team's shared pipeline templates.
* Contributes changes to shared pipeline templates in a backward-compatible way, so new options carry safe defaults and existing consumers never break.
* Maintains container image discipline, including immutable versioning, registry management, and retention policies, so a redeploy always runs exactly the image that was tested.
* Executes promotions from lower environments to production through gated, repeatable pipelines, with roll-forward as the default recovery path.
* Supports the Release team in operating the pipelines DevOps builds, helping them read a failure, retry or approve a stage, and know when to escalate back to DevOps versus the service owner.
* Investigates flaky and intermittent pipeline failures to their root cause rather than retrying past them.
* Manages change requests and work items within defined SLAs, including change-advisory and release coordination for production promotions.

Service IaC & Container Platform

* Authors and maintains infrastructure as code in Terraform for each service's cloud resources, including compute, serverless functions, API gateways, load balancers, storage, configuration, alarms, and workload IAM roles, with every change versioned, peer-reviewed, and deployed through automation.
* Treats manual changes as exceptions to be codified promptly, using plan output and state analysis to detect and resolve configuration drift.
* Deploys and operates containerized and serverless workloads on Kubernetes and managed container services, including Helm-based releases, namespaces, workload identity, and network policies.
* Configures application connectivity, including API gateways, request authorizers, service DNS records, and TLS certificates, and debugs request-path failures end to end.
* Provisions the data stores, configuration, and secrets that belong to a service, including managed relational databases with automated schema-migration pipelines, handing ongoing database operations to the Database team.

AI-Augmented DevOps

* Uses AI development tools in daily work for infrastructure code, pipeline authoring, automation scripting, troubleshooting, and documentation, while reviewing, testing, and owning everything AI produces.
* Contributes to the team's internal AI tooling across the software development lifecycle and shares effective prompts, patterns, and workflows with the team.

Service Observability & Incident Response

* Wires services into logging, metrics, and tracing as part of each service's infrastructure code, including retention and log-volume controls, and confirms a new or promoted service emits telemetry before it is handed to SRE.
* Identifies, diagnoses, and resolves delivery and service issues in production and pre-production, including failed deploys, connectivity faults, container and runtime configuration problems, and configuration drift, using observability platforms, cluster tooling, pipeline logs, and infrastructure state.
* Recognizes quickly when an issue belongs to another team and hands it off with evidence.

This role is focused on operationalizing secure, scalable, and resilient Azure platform services aligned to enterprise modernization initiatives and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) operational maturity goals.

title: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER
description:
The Senior DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, automating, securing, and operating NEMS cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure. This is an infrastructure-focused DevOps role for an engineer with a strong enterprise networking foundation who can translate architecture and security requirements into repeatable Infrastructure as Code (IaC), deployment pipelines, policy controls, and operational runbooks.

The role builds and maintains Azure landing zones, management group and subscription structures, resource groups, network security groups, routing, connectivity, identity and policy guardrails, monitoring, and shared platform services across hybrid environments. Working closely with Systems, Network, Security, Application, and vendor teams, the engineer helps NEMS deliver secure, resilient, auditable, and HIPAA-aligned cloud services while reducing manual configuration and deployment risk.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Designs, implements, and maintains Azure landing zones using Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected principles, including management groups, subscriptions, resource groups, naming standards, tagging, policy assignments, budgets, and centralized logging.
* Develops and maintains reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform and/or Bicep for Azure networking, security, compute, storage, monitoring, identity integration, and shared platform services.
* Builds and operates CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions to validate, plan, approve, deploy, and roll back infrastructure changes across development, test, disaster recovery, and production environments.
* Implements code review, branch protection, version control, state management, drift detection, automated testing, documentation, and release controls for infrastructure repositories.
* Designs and automates resource groups, virtual networks, subnets, network security groups, application security groups, route tables, Azure Firewall policies, private endpoints, Private DNS zones, load balancers, and application gateways.
* Designs and troubleshoots hybrid connectivity using ExpressRoute, site-to-site VPN, BGP, hub-and spoke and/or Azure Virtual WAN architectures, ensuring secure routing, segmentation, resiliency, and predictable failover.
* Applies network engineering fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, NAT, routing, firewall policy, TLS, proxy, packet capture, traffic-flow analysis, and root cause analysis to Azure infrastructure issues.
* Implements Azure Policy initiatives, RBAC, managed identities, service principals, privileged access controls, secrets management, and least-privilege deployment patterns in coordination with the Security team.
* Embeds security checks into infrastructure pipelines, including IaC scanning, secrets detection, policy validation, configuration compliance, and controlled exception handling.
* Configures Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Network Watcher, alerts, dashboards, diagnostic settings, and activity-log retention to improve visibility, incident response, capacity planning, and audit readiness.
* Supports Azure migration and modernization activities through discovery, dependency mapping, network readiness, landing-zone onboarding, workload placement, cutover planning, validation, and post-migration stabilization.
* Designs infrastructure for availability, backup, disaster recovery, and regional resilience based on approved recovery time and recovery point objectives; participate in failover and recovery testing.

* Maintains current architecture diagrams, module documentation, pipeline standards, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, configuration records, and recovery runbooks.
* Participates in incident response, problem management, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, change management, and rotating on-call support for critical infrastructure services.
* Collaborates with internal teams, Microsoft, cloud service providers, carriers, managed service providers, and other vendors; validates technical deliverables and ensures changes meet NEMS architecture, security, and support requirements.
* Mentors infrastructure and network team members in IaC, Git workflows, cloud networking, automation, and operational practices.
* Evaluates cloud services and engineering practices, recommends improvements, and identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, deployment speed, standardization, and cost governance.
* Performs other job duties as required by manager/supervisor.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Network Engineering, a related STEM field, or equivalent experience
* 5 years enterprise infrastructure/network engineering experience with hands on responsibility for routing, firewalls, segmentation, DNS, VPN, and hybrid connectivity.
* 3 years hands on Microsoft Azure infrastructure engineering experience in production environments.
* Demonstrated provisioning of Azure infrastructure using Terraform and/or Bicep (reusable modules, remote state, variables/outputs, environment promotion).
* Experience building infra deployment pipelines (Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions) with approvals, security checks, and controlled production releases.
* Hands on experience with Azure networking: Virtual Network, NSGs, route tables, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, Private Link, Private DNS, load balancers, and network troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities/service principals, Key Vault, Azure Policy, and privileged access concepts.
* Experience supporting highly available, regulated, or mission critical environments; strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross team collaboration skills.
* Ability to translate architecture and governance standards into tested, reusable infrastructure code while maintaining separation of duties, controlled approvals, and auditability.

**LANGUAGE:**

* Ability to speak and/or understand Chinese (Cantonese or Mandarin) is an asset.

description:

title: Data Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
As a Data Engineer II here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will play an essential role in developing and refining data pipelines that facilitate the accurate and efficient flow of information across various systems. Your efforts will be pivotal in enhancing the organization’s ability to access and utilize critical financial data seamlessly. Your primary focus will be on creating robust, scalable solutions that ensure the real-time delivery and automated processing of data from our diverse data sources to endpoint solutions. The role emphasizes collaboration with Finance stakeholders (not enterprise IT architecture) to translate business requirements into reliable, well-documented data products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines that ingest data from varied sources (financial systems, ERP/CRM, files, APIs) into Snowflake; ensure reliability, observability, and recoverability.
* Develop transformations using SQL and Python within Dataiku (recipes, flows, scenarios) and Databricks (notebooks, Jobs, Delta Lake/Spark) to produce trusted, reusable finance data marts and subject-area tables.
* Automate and orchestrate workflows (scheduling, dependency management, alerts) in Dataiku/Databricks; implement robust logging and monitoring.
* Enable Tableau analytics by publishing performant Snowflake views and semantic layers; optimize query patterns (warehouses, micro-partitions, caching) to support dashboard performance and scalability.
* Data quality and governance: implement validation rules, reconciliations/tie-outs to source systems, lineage documentation, and access controls; uphold standards for PII and financial data.
* Requirement gathering & stakeholder collaboration: work directly with Finance/FP&A, Accounting, and business analysts to translate metrics (e.g., period close, variance analysis, forecasting) into data models and pipelines.
* Performance tuning: leverage Snowflake features (e.g., Tasks, Streams, Dynamic Tables where appropriate), clustering strategies, and cost-efficient warehouse configurations.
* Version control and CI/CD: manage code in Git, contribute reviews, unit/integration tests, and promote changes through dev/test/prod.
* Process modernization: convert manual/Excel processes into automated, auditable pipelines; prototype utilities and frameworks in Python.

**Qualifications**
YOU MUST HAVE
  
  

* US Citizen status
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5 years of professional data engineering experience, including 2+ years with Snowflake (data modeling, SQL performance, warehouse administration).
* Advanced SQL and practical Python skills for data processing and automation.

WE VALUE
  
  

* Hands-on experience with Dataiku (flows, recipes, scenarios, plugins) and Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Jobs) for pipeline development and orchestration.
* Experience preparing datasets for Tableau consumption; familiarity with semantic layers, live vs. extract strategies, and performance best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with Finance/FP&A teams and translate business logic into reproducible data transformations.
* Strong documentation habits, communication skills, and commitment to data quality and operational excellence.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and data services; experience with secrets management and resource cost-optimization.
* Familiarity with Snowflake Streams, Tasks, and Dynamic Tables for incremental processing and near-real-time use cases.
* Experience with CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), pytest/unit testing, and environment promotion.
* Knowledge of data governance (cataloging, lineage, roles/policies) and best practices for financial data controls.
* Background in finance domain concepts (GL, P&L, balance sheet, budgeting & forecasting).

**Benefits Of Working For Honeywell Aerospace**
In addition to a performance-driven salary, cutting-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell Aerospace employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays.
  
  
The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
  
  
**About Us**
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.
  
  
Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
  
  
Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
  
  
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

title: Senior Data Engineer -  Healthcare Data & Audience Applications
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Zeta Global is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to build reliable, scalable data pipelines and data products for a healthcare vertical. You will be a hands-on engineer who turns complex healthcare and marketing datasets into trusted foundations for audience discovery, segmentation, activation, reporting, and measurement.

Working closely with the engineering and product team, you will help implement the team's data architecture and engineering standards while owning significant parts of the delivery lifecycle. You will contribute to well-designed, production-ready systems—not define the overall architecture or technical roadmap alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate production-grade pipelines for healthcare, identity, audience, media-exposure, and campaign-performance data using Python, SQL, Airflow, S3, Snowflake, and EMR.
* Implement maintainable data models, transformations, governed views, and reusable datasets for provider identity, claims/Rx, NPI/HCP, media, brand, and connector data.

* Implement data-quality controls, reconciliation checks, monitoring, alerting, and incident-response practices for critical data products.
* Support data onboarding and integration for healthcare partners and internal sources, including validation, normalization, and source-to-target mapping.
* Apply privacy-by-design practices for PHI/PII, including access controls, masking, approved joins, retention, and auditability.
* Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer on technical designs, code reviews, documentation, and delivery plans; mentor less-experienced engineers as needed.

**Core Technical Environment**

* Data storage & warehouse: Snowflake Native and Amazon S3.

* 5–8 years of hands-on data engineering experience, including ownership of production pipelines and data models, with experience working with healthcare data such as provider/HCP, claims, prescription, patient/DTC, or healthcare audience datasets.
* Strong Python and expert SQL skills, with demonstrated experience building transformations, optimizing queries, and diagnosing data issues.
* Hands-on experience with AWS data services, especially S3, and a modern cloud data warehouse; experience with Snowflake, Airflow, and EMR is strongly preferred.
* Experience with data modeling, schema evolution, batch processing, orchestration, testing, CI/CD, and production support practices.
* Proven ability to work with large, complex datasets and deliver reliable, well-documented data products.
* Deep, practical knowledge of HIPAA, PHI/PII handling, privacy-by-design controls, and the operational requirements of regulated healthcare data environments.
* Experience with AdTech/MarTech, identity resolution, audience onboarding, segmentation, data linkage, media measurement, attribution, or campaign reporting.
* Ability to balance healthcare privacy constraints with the need for timely, accurate audience and performance insights.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills across engineering, product, analytics, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* Experience with healthcare data providers, identity ecosystems, tokenization, clean rooms, or privacy-enhancing technologies.
* Experience with data cataloging, lineage, observability, and data-quality frameworks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, infrastructure as code, and cloud deployment workflows.
* Experience supporting reporting, attribution, or measurement products tied to campaign or business outcomes.
* Exposure to ML/AI-enabled data products or analytics workflows.

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $160,000, depending on location and experience.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer I
description:

We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it.

**About This Role**
As a Senior DevOps Engineer at LVT, you will play a pivotal role in designing, scaling, and securing the cloud infrastructure and platform engineering solutions that power our next-generation Agentic AI platform and massive IoT edge fleet. Reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager of DevOps, you will collaborate with cross-functional software and hardware engineering teams to drive automation, robust GitOps workflows, and resilient systems design. Your expertise will directly enhance the operational reliability, security, and velocity of our global intelligent site technology.
  
  
This role is based out of our Seattle, WA location. It will operate on a hybrid schedule initially, with the expectation of transitioning to a full in-person, in-office model.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Infrastructure Architecture: Own, architect, and continuously optimize cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code across multi-region production environments to support LVT’s massive scaling needs.
* Orchestration & Containerization: Manage, upgrade, and optimize high-availability Kubernetes clusters, focusing on seamless workload performance, advanced networking, and secure configurations.
* Deployment Automation: Drive the continuous adoption and maturation of GitOps practices to build robust, secure, and highly predictable deployment pipelines.
* Cloud Operations: Design and maintain scalable cloud architectures, managing core services, networking, and identity access management while actively leading cost optimization and resource efficiency strategies.
* Security & Zero-Trust Compliance: Ensure rigorous security boundaries and secrets compliance across all infrastructure layers by implementing zero-trust access frameworks and modern secrets management systems.
* Edge & IoT Enablement: Support the operational health, connectivity, and deployment workflows of our global IoT and edge fleet technology, partnering with teams to implement high-throughput messaging infrastructures.

**OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE**

* Production Experience: Brings 5+ years of proven DevOps, platform, or cloud infrastructure engineering experience within high-availability production environments.
* Kubernetes Mastery: Possesses deep hands-on experience managing Kubernetes workloads, networking, RBAC, storage, and upgrades, with a strong preference for Amazon EKS.
* Infrastructure as Code Expert: Demonstrates advanced Terraform and Terragrunt skills, with the capability to confidently own and refactor complex infrastructure module hierarchies.
* GitOps Delivery: Experienced with declarative continuous delivery methodologies and GitOps tooling, with a strong preference for ArgoCD.
* AWS Ecosystem Fluency: Exhibits deep technical knowledge of core AWS environments, including VPC design, IAM, EKS, ALB/NLB, S3, CloudWatch, and rigorous cloud cost management.
* Systems Fundamentals: Highly comfortable with Linux systems administration, advanced shell scripting, and deep debugging at the operating system level.
* Identity & Secrets Management: Proven experience managing secrets securely, with a strong preference for HashiCorp Vault , alongside exposure to zero-trust access platforms like Teleport, Boundary, or BeyondCorp.
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong written communicator who excels at documenting complex systems, authoring practical runbooks, and executing within async-first workflows.
* Advanced Domain Expertise (Plus): Experience or exposure to IoT/edge fleet management and MQTT brokers , observability platforms like Datadog or Coralogix , AWS GovCloud/FedRAMP compliance contexts , or overlay networking like NetFoundry and OpenZiti.

**Compensation**
The beginning annual salary range for this role is $151,200.00 - $176,400.00 USD and is determined by location, job-related experience, and education/training. Your total earning potential is amplified by a bonus structure tied to meeting goals, and you will become an owner from day one through our employee equity program.

Full-time benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.

All candidates must pass a drug screening and background check upon employment. Some roles may also require passing a federal background check and fingerprinting. description:
****Description****
Prescient Edge is seeking a
**Cloud Engineer**
to support a Federal Government client.
  
  
**Please note that the availability of this position is contingent upon contract award.**
****Benefits:****
At
**Prescient**
**Edge**
, we believe that acting with integrity and serving our employees is the key to everyone's success. To that end, we provide employees with a best-in-class benefits package that includes:

* A substantial retirement plan with no vesting schedule.

****Description:****

* Design, deploy, and maintain secure cloud environments in AWS and Azure, ensuring compliance with DoD cloud security frameworks and best practices.
* Configure identity and access management (IAM) solutions, enforce role-based access controls (RBAC), and manage cloud security groups and firewalls.
* Optimize cloud networking configurations, including VPC peering, VPNs, and cross-domain connectivity to ensure secure and efficient cloud operations.
* Support the development of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates to automate secure cloud deployments.
* Contribute to the Cloud Security & Performance Optimization Report, detailing cloud security configurations, resource utilization efficiencies, and compliance measures.
* Track and report Kubernetes and other workload-specific cloud resource usage by Work Order, using GovCloud-native observability tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Cost Explorer).
* Coordinate with other Work Order contractors to reconcile prepay or reservation usage against actual consumption and provide monthly reports on computer and storage allocation, tagging compliance, and projected costs.
* Advise the Government on workload placement and optimization strategies across IL2, IL4, and IL5 environments to reduce cost while maintaining performance and security compliance.
* Provision and maintain IL2, IL4, and IL5 GovCloud infrastructure using native Azure and/or AWS tools where feasible.
* Implement cloud native services for monitoring (e.g., CloudWatch, Azure Monitor), cost tracking, and compliance automation to support scalability, security, and chargeback alignment.
* Provision infrastructure in coordination IAM, Kubernetes, Data Lake, CI/CD and audit integration, and procurement and license validation.
* Provision and manage shared container environments and storage for dependent Work Orders, ensuring secure, efficient resource allocation and cross-Work Order operability.

****Requirements****
**Experience:**

* Possess the knowledge and capability to design, deploy, and maintain GovCloud-based infrastructures across AWS and Azure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security for mission-critical applications.
* Required expertise includes cloud architecture, networking, virtualization, containerization, and security best practices, with proficiency in Infrastructure as-Code (IaC) solutions such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Personnel must have experience in hybrid and multi-cloud configurations, including Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) peering, identity management (IAM), and cross-domain solutions. Strong expertise in the Authority to Operate (ATO) process is required, including preparing security documentation, conducting compliance assessments, and maintaining continuous monitoring per DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST 800-53 Rev. 5, FedRAMP, and DoD IL-4/IL 5 security mandates.
* Personnel must also optimize cloud resources for compute, storage, and networking efficiency while ensuring full compliance with DoD governance policies.
* Personnel must have experience designing, deploying, and managing AWS and Azure cloud environments with a focus on security, automation, and scalability.
* Required expertise includes Identity and Access Management (IAM), role-based access control (RBAC), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and cloud networking configurations such as VPC peering, subnets, VPNs, and security groups.
* Personnel must demonstrate proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates, ensuring secure and scalable deployments. Experience supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) processes is required, including preparing System Security Plans (SSP), Security Assessment Reports (SAR), and Plans of Action & Milestones (POA&M), and maintaining compliance with DoD governance frameworks and NIST requirements.
* Personnel must also collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement security controls in accordance with FedRAMP, RMF, and DoD IL-4/IL-5 security mandates, while optimizing cloud resource allocation for efficiency.

****Education:****

* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or five (5) years of equivalent experience in cloud engineering.
* Preferred certifications include AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, and Google Professional Cloud Architect.

****Security Clearance:****

* Must be a US citizen and able to obtain a clearance.

**Location:**

* Doral, Florida. (USSOUTHCOM Headquarters)

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Senior Cloud Engineer**

**Remote**

**Long Term**

The Cloud Engineer-Senior supports by designing, implementing, and operating secure, scalable cloud infrastructure for enterprise applications and services. This role is central to OIT's hybrid infrastructure strategy, ensuring reliable integration of cloud and on-premises environments while maintaining high availability and performance. The engineer drives automation-first operations using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices to improve consistency, speed, and operational resilience. The position enforces zero-trust and compliance requirements, supports migration and modernization initiatives, and provides technical leadership across cloud engineering activities.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain SEC Public Trust (or higher if required).

Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering and Operations**

* - Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure solutions in Microsoft Azure and AWS, with Azure as the primary platform and AWS support focused on integration with project-team-managed workloads and potential future expansion.
* - Build and maintain cloud networking, storage, compute, app services, virtualization, and containerized environments.
* - Ensure scalability, resiliency, and high availability through proactive performance tuning, capacity planning, and operational optimization.

title: Software Engineer(Python/Backend) - Professional Services Firm - $130,000-$160,000
description:
Two openings on a growing Data Operations team, building an enterprise data platform from the ground up.

This is a fully remote role with a U.S.-based professional services firm. Their technology, AI and data teams are expanding fast, and you’d be joining at exactly the right moment.

The team is building its data platform on Microsoft Fabric. The Data Engineers own the core pipelines, and you’ll be the Python engineer who handles everything around them: building custom integrations with third-party APIs, pulling data out of older systems that don’t connect easily, parsing messy and deeply nested data, and automating routine work alongside the Cloud and Database teams. No two weeks look the same, and you’ll be the person the team turns to when the standard tools can’t solve a problem.

This role suits a software engineer who enjoys working with data, rather than a data engineer or data scientist. You’ll have strong production Python experience, ideally from backend, integrations or automation work, and you’ll be comfortable consuming RESTful APIs and dealing with authentication, pagination and rate limits. You’ll parse and transform JSON, XML and CSV using Pandas, write solid SQL, and have some exposure to PySpark or a platform like Fabric, Databricks or Synapse. You write clean, tested code, use Git and CI/CD as standard, and know that a “quick script” often ends up being something the business relies on.

Just as important, you can connect your work to the bigger picture. You’ll be working with stakeholders across the firm, so you’ll need to understand what the business needs, explain technical trade-offs in plain terms, and show how your work makes a difference.

You’ll get full remote flexibility, hands-on experience with a modern data platform, and a real part in the AI and data initiatives shaping how the firm operates.

Ready to build something that matters?

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Marketing
description:
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join our Data Team with a dedicated focus on Marketing. In this role, you'll play a critical part in helping our Marketing team make data-driven decisions by creating data-driven solutions, using strategic context to develop success metrics, and providing valuable insights through clear, impactful data products and visualizations.
  
  
As a senior member of the BI function, you will lead development efforts, drive best practices, and serve as a trusted advisor to cross-functional stakeholders, particularly with Marketing.
  
  
**About Talkiatry**
Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.
  
  
Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.
  
  
Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.
  
  
**You Will**

* Build and maintain clean, scalable data models and pipelines to support marketing analytics and reporting using tools like Snowflake, dbt, and Databricks
* Collaborate closely with Marketing stakeholders to understand business goals and translate them into data requirements and insightful data products
* Develop and maintain user-friendly BI solutions to monitor marketing performance, campaign effectiveness, and key KPIs
* Build data models that match our robust data governance, data quality, and documentation
* Lead the development of self-service analytics tools that empower Marketing team members to independently explore data
* Drive the implementation of best practices in data modeling, performance optimization, and reporting workflows

**You Have**

* 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related role
* Advanced SQL skills and a strong understanding of data modeling concepts
* Experience with modern data stack tools including Snowflake, dbt, and Databricks

* Strong understanding of data visualization principles and dashboard design
* Familiarity with marketing platforms and tools such as Iterable is preferred
* Basic experience or exposure to A/B testing and experimental analysis
* Experience working cross-functionally with non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to present insights clearly to all levels of the organization

* Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast-paced startup
